description: Listed Building Consent for the erection of a two storey side extension and single storey side infill extension to southern elevation, part first floor extension to northern elevation, creation of a courtyard with gate, relocation of a door and window on the west elevation, repositioning and addition of windows on the ground floor northern elevation, provision of rooflights to the east facing roofs and associated internal alterations following the demolition of the existing conservatory. Full Planning Permission P/2025/2541.
